LifePath Vietnam
Concept proposal · Data for Life 2026
From life event to real outcome

Public services that find you.

An AI case manager that understands what happened in a citizen's life, discovers relevant procedures and unclaimed benefits, then guides every action until completion.

Not another government chatbot. A verified, consent-based action engine.
Citizen journey previewVerified sources
How it works

One conversation. Three coordinated engines.

The citizen describes a goal in ordinary language. LifePath turns it into a structured case without requiring them to know procedure names or responsible agencies.

01

Life Event Engine

Understands context, asks only relevant questions and maps every connected procedure across agencies.

Output: personalised journey
02

Entitlement Engine

Matches the citizen's consented profile against eligibility rules to uncover benefits they may not know exist.

Output: explainable eligibility
03

Action Engine

Checks documents, pre-fills forms, sequences dependencies, tracks cases and helps resolve rejected submissions.

Output: completed outcomes
Proven foundations

Global lessons, redesigned for Vietnam.

LifePath combines two public-service models already implemented at scale, then adds an execution layer suited to Vietnam's VNeID and digital-government direction.

Singapore

LifeSG

  • Services organised around major life events
  • 100+ government services in one place
  • Personalised recommendations and eligibility checks
  • Application updates and reminders
+
China · Shanghai

Policy finds people

  • Data matches citizens and businesses to policies
  • Benefits discovered proactively
  • Application-free or one-confirmation services
  • Direct access to eligible support
Life-event services + proactive benefit discovery + trackable execution = LifePath Vietnam
Why this problem

A stronger interpretation of BTL86-40.

BTL86-40 identifies the need for a digital public-service assistant. LifePath keeps that official problem statement while moving beyond information retrieval.

01

National-scale relevance

Nearly every citizen encounters multi-step procedures and may miss support they are entitled to receive.

02

Aligned with VNeID

It uses consented identity and document data as the foundation for simpler, more personalised public services.

03

Demonstrable without privileged data

A prototype can use official public rules and simulated citizen records while clearly showing future integration.

04

Value on both sides

Citizens complete tasks more easily; agencies receive cleaner applications and insight into recurring service failures.

Differentiation

Information is not completion.

The competitive advantage is the structured procedure graph, explainable eligibility and closed-loop case management, not the language model alone.

Hackathon scope

Build three journeys deeply, not thousands superficially.

A focused prototype can prove the platform model while remaining credible within the competition timeline.

End-to-end prototype

01Having a child: registration, residence, health insurance and family support.
02Losing a job: unemployment insurance, healthcare, training and family benefits.
03Opening a restaurant: business registration, tax, food safety and local permits.

The strategic shift

Today, digital government often waits for citizens to locate the correct service. LifePath reverses that relationship while keeping citizens in control of their data and every final decision.

“Tell us what happened. We will show what to do, what you can claim, and what happens next.”
